name: Cards
description: Field types/widgets/formatters that turn entities (e.g. block content) into styled “card” components with optional child cards.
project_description:
Cards is an extension of the the compound field for Drupal 8 that is a combination of an entity reference field and a view mode. 

 Cards takes this one step further and allows for the addition of a large range of modifier css classes to be added to the rendered entity allowing an end user further control of how that entity is displayed, modifications that wouldnt necessarily warrant a new view mode. Such as color, height, icon and width etc.
